name: agencyvoice
description: AgencyVoice AI — clonagem de voz própria para campanhas

scripts.dev: concurrently -n ai,gateway,client -c teal,blue,amber "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n ai,gateway -c teal,blue "npm run start:ai" "npm run start --prefix server"
scripts.setup:ai: cd ai && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip && .venv/bin/pip install torch torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
